_comment: Your own changes to skills, applied over the game data when the server starts (restart after editing). Key: skill id (the Grimoire's skill search shows ids). All fields are optional: damageMultiplier scales damage (or healing) at every rank; ranks sets exact numbers for single ranks, numbered as in game (1 = the first rank), with initial and base as in the skill formula ceil(base + initial x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor))); cooldown (seconds), energy and castTime set every rank. name is only a label for you. The PvP version of a skill gets the same changes. Entries starting with _ are ignored, so remove the _ to switch an example on. Damage over time (Rupture's bleed, poisons, burns) is the skill's status effect, set with dotMultiplier (scales every rank's per-tick amount), dotRanks (exact amount and base for single ranks: per tick = ceil(base + amount x (1 + sqrt(ability / 100) + sqrt(stat / divisor)))), dotDuration (seconds) and dotTick (seconds between ticks; most tick every 5). The same status-effect fields also work under effect… names (effectMultiplier, effectRanks, effectDuration) for buffs and debuffs that aren't damage over time, e.g. how much skill evasion Bless gives.

214.name: Rupture (owner, 2026-10-15: bleed ticks every second for 5 seconds at 80% of an original tick each, 8 s cooldown)
